spec: §12.1: "The checker proves each of the three matrices positive definite ... the interval lower bound of every pivot is strictly positive, and rejects otherwise"
derivation: For Phi=0, take Y=diag(0,-1,0,0), mu=1, bound=1. The first pivot is 0, not strictly positive; the next diagonal is negative. Interval Cholesky cannot prove positive definiteness, so reject regardless of the scalar bound.
